title: tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors: committed vectors mismatch stdlib generator (failing on branch)
description: Discovered while running the suite for ilye.1; pre-existing on beads-worker-4, not caused by it. tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py::test_committed_ipv6_address_vectors_match_stdlib_generator fails: the committed key-derived IPv6 address vectors do not match the stdlib-based generator output. Cross-implementation vector drift — needs regeneration against the canonical generator or a fix to whichever side drifted. Verify with: cd python && python -m pytest tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py -q.
